name: @harness/server
description: Filesystem-backed API for Harness remote clients

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @harness/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/opencode-v2-context-bridge.ts --outfile dist/opencode-v2-context-bridge.js --target node --format esm && bun build src/opencode-plugins/managed-policy-next.ts src/opencode-plugins/managed-policy.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-chrome-devtools.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-extensions-preview.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-capabilities-knowledge.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-office-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-spreadsheets.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-pdf-attachments.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-anthropic-adaptive-thinking.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-anthropic-tool-schema.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-title-recovery.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-audit.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-provider-keys.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-gateway-quota.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-gateway-quota-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-provider-filters-v2.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-context-v2.ts --root src/opencode-plugins --outdir dist/opencode-plugins --target node --format esm && node scripts/copy-pdfium-wasm.mjs dist/opencode-plugins
scripts.build:bin: pnpm --filter @harness/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile dist/bin/harness-server
scripts.build:bin:all: pnpm --filter @harness/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun ./script/build.ts --outdir dist/bin --target bun-darwin-arm64 --target bun-darwin-x64 --target bun-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-arm64 --target bun-windows-x64 --target bun-windows-arm64
scripts.build:npm-bundle: pnpm --filter @harness/types build && pnpm build:enterprise-mcp-client && bun build src/cli.ts --target node --format esm --external bun:sqlite --external drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite --external jsonc-parser --outfile dist/npm-bundle/harness-server.mjs
scripts.prepare:npm: pnpm build && pnpm build:npm-bundle && pnpm build:web-ui && node scripts/publish-npm.mjs --prepare-only
scripts.publish:npm: pnpm build && pnpm build:npm-bundle && pnpm build:web-ui && node scripts/publish-npm.mjs
scripts.test:core: bun --conditions=development test src/engine-npm-local.test.ts src/paths.test.ts src/provider-key-vault.test.ts src/opencode-plugins/harness-provider-keys.test.ts src/headless-threads.e2e.test.ts src/session-groups.e2e.test.ts src/opencode-proxy.e2e.test.ts src/authorized-folders.e2e.test.ts src/inbox-upload-approval.e2e.test.ts src/artifact-files.e2e.test.ts src/effective-permissions.e2e.test.ts src/cloud-mcp-reconcile.e2e.test.ts src/cloud-provider-sync.e2e.test.ts src/desktop-cloud-sync-preserves-imports.e2e.test.ts src/runtime-config-patch-reload.e2e.test.ts src/engine-instance-eviction.e2e.test.ts src/tokens.test.ts src/workspace-export-safety.test.ts src/serve-node.test.ts src/opencode-v2-migration.test.ts src/cloud-mcp-health.test.ts src/cloud-mcp-v2.test.ts
